title: Towards the Query Complexity of Sampling under Strong Log-Concavity and Log-Sobolev Inequalities
abstract: arXiv:2611.05813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the query complexity of sampling from smooth distributions on $\mathbb R^d$ using first-order oracles. For $d$-dimensional strongly log-concave targets with condition number $\kappa=2$, we prove that any randomized sampler requires $\exp({\Omega(\log^{1/3} d)})$ queries even from a constant warm start. This rules out polylogarithmic dimension dependence and strictly separates strongly log-concave sampling from Gaussian sampling. For targets with $L$-smooth potentials satisfying an $\alpha$-log-Sobolev inequality with $\kappa= L/\alpha$, we prove an $\Omega(\kappa)$ query lower bound for $d\gtrsim\log^2\kappa$. This shows that log-Sobolev sampling is strictly harder than strongly log-concave sampling.   Our proofs construct instance-dependent tests that target samples typically pass but outputs of algorithms making few queries typically fail. translated_title: 迈向强对数凹性与对数Sobolev不等式下采样的查询复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 $\mathbb R^d$ 上使用一阶预言机从光滑分布中采样的查询复杂度。对于条件数 $\kappa=2$ 的 $d$ 维强对数凹目标分布，我们证明任何随机采样器即使从一个常数温启动出发，也需要 $\exp({\Omega(\log^{1/3} d)})$ 次查询。这排除了多对数级别的维度依赖性，并严格地将强对数凹采样与高斯采样区分开来。对于势函数为 $L$-光滑且满足 $\alpha$-对数Sobolev不等式（其中 $\kappa= L/\alpha$）的目标分布，当 $d\gtrsim\log^2\kappa$ 时，我们证明了 $\Omega(\kappa)$ 的查询次数下界。这表明对数Sobolev采样严格难于强对数凹采样。我们的证明构造了实例相关的检验方法，这些检验能被目标分布的真实样本通过，但查询次数较少的算法的输出通常无法通过。对于强对数凹目标分布，我们将一列隐藏的高斯分布嵌入到高维……
tldr: 该论文证明了强对数凹分布采样即使有温启动也需要超多对数次查询，从而与高斯采样严格分离，且证明了对数Sobolev不等式条件下的采样查询复杂度下界为 $\Omega(\kappa)$，严格难于强对数凹采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that strongly log-concave sampling requires super-polylogarithmic queries even with a warm start, strictly separating it from Gaussian sampling, and establishes an $\Omega(\kappa)$ query lower bound showing that log-Sobolev sampling is strictly harder than strongly log-concave sampling.
